description:
Full Planning
Application for the demolition of existing buildings and structures (Use Class
B8 and Sui Generis) and the comprehensive redevelopment on the site to provide
a mixed use development comprising 2360sqm of industrial floorspace (falling
within flexible Use Classes E(g), B2, and/or B8 ), together with 249
residential units (Use Class C3) in a range of unit sizes within buildings of
up to 14 floors; the provision of an area of new north-south public realm
within the site and the facilitation of future pedestrian access across the
Ripple; provision of car and cycle parking and revised access points, including
access from and to adjoining sites; and the widening of the public realm to
Thames Road.
